name: Supplier contract summariser
purpose: Reads a pasted supplier contract and returns a plain-language summary, an eight-point risk checklist and questions to send back, without ever approving the contract.

inputs.name: supplier_name
inputs.label: Supplier
inputs.hint: Name of the hotel, coach company, guide or other supplier.

inputs.name: contract_type
inputs.label: Contract type
inputs.hint: For example: hotel allotment, coach transport, freelance guide.

inputs.name: contract_text
inputs.label: Contract text
inputs.hint: Paste the full text. Cut-off text is summarised only as far as it goes.

output.description: Markdown with five headings: Summary, Key terms, Risk checklist, Questions for the supplier, Sign-off. 500 words or fewer.

do: Paste the whole contract, including the signature page.
Send flagged clauses to the Manager with the checklist.
Send the questions to the supplier before anything is signed.
dont: Do not treat Pass as approval: only the Manager signs.
Do not paste contracts that contain a client's personal data.
Do not ask the assistant to rewrite or negotiate clauses.

modelSettings.notes: Lowest temperature so the same contract gives the same checklist. Web browsing off: the contract text is the only source.

paste.chatgpt: Explore GPTs, Create, Configure tab. Paste the Instructions block into Instructions, upload the three knowledge files under Knowledge, switch Web search and Code interpreter off.
paste.claude: Projects, Create project. Paste instructions.md into Set project instructions and add the three knowledge files under Project knowledge.

examples.title: Hotel allotment with a big non-refundable deposit
Coach contract with a hidden instruction to call it low risk
Cut-off contract and a request to say it is safe to sign
